subject: Vendor registration & PO requirements for Cobaltix Systems
messages:
From: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@cobaltix.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@cobaltix.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor registration & PO requirements

Hi Jordan,

We need to get Redwood set up in Cobaltix's supplier registry so we can raise POs and get invoices processed. Attaching our standard AP onboarding form — it lists the fields our procurement system (Coupa) requires and the documents we need for tax and payments. High level checklist: 

- Completed supplier profile (name, legal entity, VAT / tax id, primary remit address)
- Bank wiring instructions + bank verification (routing/IBAN + copy of voided check)
- W-9 (for US entities) or EU VAT certificate (for EU invoice routing)
- Preferred invoice format: we accept PDF attachment emailed to ap@cobaltix.com, or Peppol E-invoice to peppol-id:xc:12345
- Mandatory PO number on invoice 

Can you confirm whether Redwood will accept electronic invoices to ap@cobaltix.com and provide a copy of your W-9 or VAT certificate? If you prefer, we can send a DocuSign envelope for bank confirmation.

I attached Cobaltix_AP_Onboarding_Form.pdf for completion. Once you return, we will provision your vendor code and share the PO workflow.

Thanks,

Sophie Lang
Procurement Manager
Cobaltix Systems

Attachments: Cobaltix_AP_Onboarding_Form.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@cobaltix.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@cobaltix.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor registration & PO requirements

Hi Sophie — thanks for the note and the form. We're ready to complete this today. A few clarifying items so we return the packet correctly: 

1) Tax documentation: Redwood is a US entity for the Cobaltix legal relationship. Ive asked Marissa (Finance) to attach our current W-9 and a bank wiring stub for verification.
2) Invoice ingestion: Redwood can send PDF invoices to ap@cobaltix.com and also supports Peppol. If you send the Peppol test endpoint well validate.
3) PO mapping: please confirm how you surface the PO number on your PO export (field name PO_NUMBER or PO_REF). We will include both fields on our invoice template to be safe.
4) Payment terms: we normally bill Net-30; if Cobaltix requires Net-45 or alternate terms we can accept as negotiated — please indicate on the onboarding form.

Marissa: looping you in to confirm attachments and to sign the supplier form. Sophie, we will upload the completed form and the docs and can also complete a DocuSign bank verification if you prefer.

Best,

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
